Composition follows the standard 8-section vertical arc with limited structural surprise: three separate sections are card grids (method 4-card, services 3-card, testimonials 3-card), leaning on repeated card-grid rhythm rather than truly varied layouts. Brief asks for 'stark structured blocks' which it delivers, but sameness risk vs other card-heavy pages.

Brief calls for 'snappy, abrupt, high-impact' motion and hard transitions; the only interaction is a generic 0.1s transform/box-shadow transition on buttons (neobrutalist.css:100-102) with no hover-translate/shadow-collapse press effect actually wired â€” motion promise underdelivered.

Every content section is the same recipe: bordered block + nb-shadow + a colored fill; visually cohesive but the hero, intro, cta and contact blocks share near-identical framing, so section-to-section variety comes mostly from fill color rather than structure.
